text:
Eli Torres: quick fragmenting of a tiny 'safety-net' play we can send to customers when renewals look soft. want it super copy/pasteable for SAs.
Maya Chen: perfect. keep it > actionable and < verbose.
Eli Torres: ok paste:```Customer safety-net: 4-step warmprefill + escalation micro-play for renewal-risk accounts
1) Snapshot: share last 72h p95 latency, 7d token delta, and error %. If p95 > 750ms or errors > 1% mark as "needs attention".
2) Minimal prefill (customer action): run top-2 prompts with prefill_tokens=900, spacing 12s, 3 repeats. This usually seeds KV without big cost.
3) Server suggestions: set batch_window=40-80ms, concurrency cap=2 per user; keep quantization off for first 48h after prefill.
4) Short feedback pulse (1 question + optional): "How helpful was the assistant today? (0-10)". If <=5, open a 30m triage.```
Zara Khan: add a one-line email snippet for SAs to use.
Eli Torres: good call. snippet:```Subject: Quick assist check after warmup
Hi <Name>,
We ran a short warmup for your assistant to improve latency and consistency. Two quick asks: 1) Overall helpfulness today (0-10): ___ 2) Any accuracy regressions? (yes/no + short note). If helpfulness <=5 were available for a 30min triage.
Thanks,
<SA name>
```
Ravi Menon: tactical prefill curl (smaller endpoint, lower tokens):```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill-mini 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"account_id":"acct_X","model":"assist-lite","samples":[{"prompt":"<prompt1>","tokens":900},{"prompt":"<prompt2>","tokens":900}],"spacing_seconds":12}'
```Note: run <=2 concurrent clients.
Maya Chen: add observability keys customers should share in the reply.
Eli Torres: telemetry keys: cs.request_id, redwood.latency.p95, redwood.errors.rate, redwood.cache.hit_ratio, redwood.stream.gap_p90, cs.tokens_out. ask customers to paste these values or screenshot the dashboard.
Zara Khan: escalation matrix (very short): High risk = usage drop >40% OR helpfulness <=4 -> schedule 30m triage with eng+CS within 48h. Medium = 15-40% drop OR p95 600-750ms -> offer targeted prefill + 7d monitor. Low = stable usage + helpfulness >=7 -> standard cadence.
Ravi Menon: tiny healthcheck snippet to confirm cache warming (python):```python
# run after prefill completes
def cache_warm(client):
    m = client.query_metrics("redwood.cache.hit_ratio", window="1h")
    return getattr(m, 'p90', 0) >= 0.58
```
Maya Chen: love it. final ask: can someone add a line that tells SAs to pin to previous model variant when investigating quality drops? word it gently.
Eli Torres: done "
